svg.title: Blue Curve VI
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Normalized observed support proportions only; physical dimensions unknown. Painting at upper-right of the gallery photograph. Arc and wedge angles approximate because reference is oblique. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
